test_title: PYST 1: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of C. Only two people sit between C and U. Only two people sit between A and V. V sits to the immediate left of C. T sits to the immediate right of W. Who sits at third position from the left end of the line?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, T, U, V and W are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) Only two people sit to the right of C. 

2) Only two people sit between C and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/919124e9f19c6eac5410b54a86140d471dac9c2f86628c1766c74a65a263c6ad.png] 

3) V sits to the immediate left of C.

4) Only two people sit between A and V.

6) T sits to the immediate right of W.

The only remaining person is B who will be positioned at the only position left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a3bb278ee734c9f258c86ee5a6b4b6f478c76ec51149bedabb5d95d147e9913.png] 

Thus, B sits at third position from the left end of the line.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
